capability: One fact, the same in every helper's brief
title: One fact at every joint.

hook.picture: Close on the whale splitting the line into two arms toward two pods, and copying a date card onto each arm.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: My two helpers were told two different deadlines.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: team lead who split one task across two AI helpers

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: many forks along the line, each with copied cards. Three more forks split off, every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each time one copy drifts and the two answers fail to meet.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each copy gets changed on its own.

stakes.body: Two halves of the work are built for different dates, and nobody notices until they are joined.

solution_hint: Send one fact. Check every copy.

metaphor.body: The brief forks into two arms, one per helper; a fact lives once on the trunk and both arms read it through the fork, so a changed copy lights up the fork instead of travelling.

steps.picture: The date card lifts off both arms and sits once on the trunk, before the fork.
Both arms draw a thin thread from the trunk card through the fork; both pods read the same card.
steps.words: One fact. Every helper reads the same card.

steps.picture: Both pods start work, pulses climbing both arms together.
Push-in on the fork: the whale edits one arm's copy. The fork glows rust and the send stops; both pods wait.
steps.sound: The unison splits into a beating interval

steps.picture: The whale fixes the trunk card; both copies turn teal and the fork gets a tick.
Ticks ripple up both arms to the fork.
steps.words: Checks live where parts meet: seams.

real_case.claim: Context Atoms checks types, fact consistency across delegations, confidentiality and recursion bounds before sending; a disagreement is a RED finding, never last-write-wins.

honest_limit.picture: The trunk card itself carries a rust smudge (the wrong date); both arms read it, the fork glows teal, both pods answer with a tick and the same wrong date.
honest_limit.words: Both helpers agree. Both are wrong.

not_this.body: Agreement is not the same as true.

ending_pattern.body: FELT framing: the two pods face each other across the fork. Their chips flip to the same tick at the same moment, and the two halves of work meet and join with no gap.
ending_pattern.callback: The facing tick and cross of bar 2 become two matching ticks, and the gap of bar 3 closes, in the same close framing.

end_belief.body: Write each fact once. Check every copy.
